interpretation: The three legacy K=1 stock-labelled proxies are deterministic, boundary-clean and mechanically separable on the same inputs, but Portra-versus-Ektar separation is weak and several per-source medians are below one Delta E76. AO6 is much farther from legacy Velvia and remains only a Velvia 50 display-proxy Look Approximation baseline. No target-film observation was scored, so the run cannot establish stock closeness or stock distinguishability.
next_leaf: equalize rights-cleared, provenance-bound Velvia 50, Portra 400 and Ektar 100 target evidence before admitting adaptive LUT, nearest-neighbour, medoid, sparse retrieval or K greater than 1 comparisons
claim_ceiling: Mechanics and safety evidence for three legacy stock-labelled K=1 film-inspired/display-proxy operators on identical CC0 digital inputs. No target-film closeness, stock distinguishability, calibrated response, multi-stock completion, product promotion or population preference claim.
